name: Electra Consumer Products (1970) Ltd
summary: Electra Consumer Products (1970) Ltd manufactures, imports, exports, distributes, sells, and services various consumer electrical products in Israel. It offers heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems; and retails consumer electronics and cellular telephones and accessories under brands including Electra, Elco, Miele, Liebherr, Sauter, Philips, Meister, Breville, Jetpoint, TCL, Midea, Sage, Daikin, Cecotec, JTV, and Samsung. The company also retails food products and other consumables under the Carrefour brand; operates the 7-Eleven chain; and develops and constructs commercial real estate properties.
